mentions.name: Papillon
mentions.description: This is a real-time collaborative workspace for product teams that brings chat, docs, files, links, tasks, whiteboards, and calls into one place, organized around project channels instead of jumping between tools like Slack, Notion, and Linear. It aims to feel instant with a hacker/IDE aesthetic and works offline. Teams can also build small apps with AI directly inside the workspace—such as shared support rotas, spreadsheets, dashboards, or custom workflows—running in an isolated Cloudflare sandbox and easily accessible to the team. It is live as a web app and a macOS app built with Tauri, with more platforms planned, and the website includes security/trust info and uptime history.
mentions.problem: Teams jump between separate tools like Slack, Notion, and Linear, and some are hesitant to adopt a tool built by a solo developer as a side project due to trust concerns.
mentions.audience: Product teams seeking an all-in-one collaborative workspace
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Papillon: https://papillon.so, a real-time collaborative workspace for product teams.
